title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
title_zh: β-Flow：结合扩散与流基后验采样的通用方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的“即插即用”方法 $β$-Flow，通过结合流和扩散模型来解决线性逆问题中的先验问题。 Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的“即插即用”方法 $β$-Flow，通过结合流模型和扩散模型来解决线性逆问题中的先验问题。流匹配和扩散模型正越来越多地用作线性逆问题的先验，然而，大多数方法都针对某一类轨迹先验专门设计。 虽然已有“即插即用”方法被提出，但这些方法会隐式地消除引导轨迹的相关性，导致先验分布过于宽泛，在数据稀疏时可能难以有效工作。 本研究提出了 $β$-Flow：一种通用的“即插即用”方法，通过相关性参数 $β$ 实现流模型、扩散模型和去相关先验的统一，并通过置信度参数 $κ$ 控制路径分布的约束强度。 每一步仅需对去噪网络进行一次前向评估，随后执行高斯条件化步骤。 该步骤是一个精确的卡尔曼更新过程，不依赖于网络的梯度。 我们证明，许多现有的引导采样器都可以被解释为我们方法的实例或近似形式，它们各自隐式地使用了不同的轨迹先验和算子来替代卡尔曼增益。 从这一视角出发，我们从方法的隐式偏差和假设角度进行了定性比较。 我们在 4 个数据集上针对 7 类逆问题进行了测试，结果表明该方法在 PSNR 和 SSIM 指标上始终达到当前最优水平。 此外，我们还展示了这种先验控制的有效性：当观测信息较少时，高置信度的强相关性（严格先验）效果最佳；而当观测信息较多时，低相关性则更合适，这反映了先验与似然在贝叶斯推断中的互补作用。
